note: DRAFT — v0.2.1 / B-004 Warrior skill questlines. Discoverable: Power Strike and Rage start on a level-up; Earthbreaker and Flame Cleave start when the rare drop is picked up or inspected. Completing a line unlocks that skill at rank 1; further ranks train at Calden. Soul Guard is parked (see Pitch Book). `desc` is player-facing; `notes` is design-only. Rewards are on the last step. `trigger` is level:N or item:<id>. Gates are checked when Calden would finish the line.  v0.2.3: A Crack in the Dirt and Hot Edge only unlock training; they do not grant rank 1. The Weight of a Swing and Blood Up still grant rank 1.  v0.2.4: The Dirt Path (ql_dirt_path), giver Pell, prereq sq_first_passive / first passive point. 4 Crows, reach the Banks, 5 Moles and 3 Ember Beetles, return to Pell. No skill grant.  v0.2.6: Ila kit = new Nature rank-1 recipe; quest gear gifts are exact; Hot Edge can start from Calden at level 6.  v0.2.7: ql_paths, Calden's short tutorial for Paths (talk, open the tree, train Power Strike rank 2, report back).  v0.2.8: ql_magic, Tamsin's Magician Path tutorial (talk, open the Magician tab, train Magic Bolt, report back).

rows.name: The Weight of a Swing
rows.desc: Calden wants to see a real blow, not just a practice swing.
rows.objective: Go to the practice post by the east gate in Meadow Town.
rows.notes: B-004. Starts at level 2. Short on purpose so the first skill is not gated for long.

rows.name: The Weight of a Swing
rows.desc: A handful of twigs will do for a first lesson.
rows.objective: Collect 4 Twig and bring them to Calden.
rows.notes: Turn in consumes the twigs.

rows.name: The Weight of a Swing
rows.desc: Land three honest swings on the post, then Calden will teach the first real blow.
rows.objective: Land 3 basic attacks (F) on the practice post.
rows.notes: Only the basic F swing counts, not skills. Reward grants Power Strike at rank 1.

rows.name: Blood Up
rows.desc: Rage hits harder — and so do the things that hit you back. Talk to Calden.
rows.objective: Talk to Calden about the bargain of Rage.
rows.notes: B-004. Starts at level 3. Calden explains the deal.

rows.name: Blood Up
rows.desc: Walk out to where the pasture meets the dirt path.
rows.objective: Reach the east end of Sunny Pasture, near the dirt path.
rows.notes: Place check, around the Crow stretch / east portal.

rows.name: Blood Up
rows.desc: Wool-Shoulder will not back down. Stay in the fight, then return to Calden.
rows.objective: Defeat Wool-Shoulder in the east pasture and return to Calden.
rows.notes: Named Wool Sheep variant. The point is to stay in a fight that hits back, not to kite it from town.

rows.name: A Crack in the Dirt
rows.desc: The cracked stone wants to be more than a rock. Calden will know.
rows.objective: Bring the Cracked Bank Stone to Calden (level 3 and 5 STR).
rows.notes: B-004. Starts on pickup/inspect of cracked_bank_stone. You can find it early; Calden waits for the gate.

rows.name: A Crack in the Dirt
rows.desc: The lesson is in the banks themselves.
rows.objective: Reach the Dirt Banks.
rows.notes: Place: dirt_banks area.

rows.name: A Crack in the Dirt
rows.desc: Pebbles and grit from the cuts. Bring them back.
rows.objective: Collect 8 Pebble and 6 Earth Grit, then bring them to Calden.
rows.notes: Moles and sprites. Turn in consumes the mats. Unlock quest itself uses materials already in the sheet.

rows.name: A Crack in the Dirt
rows.desc: Bank-Cracker waits in a hollow of the banks.
rows.objective: Defeat Bank-Cracker in the Dirt Banks and return to Calden.
rows.notes: Named Burrow Mole. Reward: Earthbreaker rank 1. Nature Essence ×12 does not skip rank 2 (r2 still costs on the ×1.6 curve from 40).  v0.2.3: completing this line unlocks training at Calden (rank 0 → 1 is paid), and does NOT grant the skill at rank 1. Power Strike and Rage still grant rank 1.

rows.name: Hot Edge
rows.desc: The scale is still warm. Calden will only take it when you are ready.
rows.objective: Bring the Smoldering Scale to Calden (level 6 and 10 STR).
rows.notes: B-004. v0.2.6: starts when Calden is talked to at level 6 (he shows a gold !), or on pickup/inspect of smoldering_scale at any level. The level 6 / 10 STR gate applies to turning the scale in, not to discovering the quest. Ember Beetle 20% and Spark Bug 12% drop the scale, and the first Ember Beetle killed at level 6+ always does (once per character).

rows.name: Hot Edge
rows.desc: Warm Grain from the beetles. Enough to kindle a lesson.
rows.objective: Collect 6 Warm Grain from Ember Beetles and bring them to Calden.
rows.notes: Turn in consumes the grain.

rows.name: Hot Edge
rows.desc: Cinderback leaves a Live Ember. Bring it to Calden.
rows.objective: Defeat Cinderback in the Dirt Banks and bring its Live Ember to Calden.
rows.notes: Named Ember Beetle, guaranteed Live Ember. Reward: Flame Cleave rank 1. Elemental Essence ×12 is a taste, not a skipped rank.  v0.2.3: completing this line unlocks training at Calden (rank 0 → 1 is paid), and does NOT grant the skill at rank 1. Power Strike and Rage still grant rank 1.

rows.name: The Dirt Path
rows.desc: Pell has a job past the east pasture, into the dirt.
rows.objective: Talk to Pell at the east gate in Meadow Town.
rows.notes: B-001 / v0.2.4. Starts once the player has spent a first passive point (prereq sq_first_passive, or any passive rank / pending upgrade). Giver Pell. Does not grant a skill.

rows.name: The Dirt Path
rows.desc: The crows at the east end of the pasture keep the path.
rows.objective: Defeat 4 Crows in the east of Sunny Pasture.
rows.notes: B-001. Hunt counts (not a named foe). Advances automatically at 4.

rows.name: The Dirt Path
rows.desc: The dirt path at the far east of the pasture leads on.
rows.objective: Take the dirt path at the far east of the pasture into the Dirt Banks.
rows.notes: B-001. Reach dirt_banks. Auto-advances.

rows.name: The Dirt Path
rows.desc: A first mixed hunt in the banks — moles and warm beetles — then back to Pell.
rows.objective: Defeat 5 Burrow Moles and 3 Ember Beetles, then return to Pell.
rows.notes: B-001. Hunt 5 moles + 3 beetles, then talk to Pell to complete. Rewards: 120 XP, 25 copper, Nature Essence ×8, Elemental Essence ×5, Meadow Dew ×2 — a taste, not a skipped rank.
rows.reward_items: nature_essence x8; elemental_essence x5; meadow_dew x2

rows.name: The Quiet Work
rows.desc: Ila has something slower than a swing to show you.
rows.objective: Talk to Ila at her bench in Meadow Town.
rows.notes: v0.2.5. Introduces the Nature / Elemental trees. Auto-starts when The Weight of a Swing is done. Giver Ila. Guides spending the first passive point, which is also The Dirt Path’s prereq — completing this (or spending the point) opens Pell’s hunt. Does not grant a skill. Starter-kit materials are given at step 2 (exact Nature Essence rank-1 cost) so the spend is possible at this level.

rows.name: The Quiet Work
rows.desc: A handful of pasture cuttings, and Ila will show you the rest.
rows.objective: Bring Ila 8 Twig and 4 Bark.
rows.notes: v0.2.6. Collect/turn-in. On turn-in Ila gives the rank-1 Nature Essence kit, which now equals the new rank-1 recipe exactly: Nature Essence 20, Pebble 16, Bark 12, Copper 18 (in code, not a sheet reward, so it lands mid-quest).

rows.name: The Quiet Work
rows.desc: Open the tree, and set a first root going.
rows.objective: Open the passive tree (T) and start a first rank, then return to Ila.
rows.notes: v0.2.5. Completes when a first passive point is spent (same hook as Dirt Path) and the player talks to Ila. Rewards are a taste: 80 XP, 15 copper, Meadow Dew ×2. No skill grant. If a save already has a passive rank, talking to Ila at this step finishes it.

rows.name: A Warm Coat
rows.desc: Mara has a coat in mind, if the pasture will spare the wool.
rows.objective: Talk to Mara in Meadow Town.
rows.notes: v0.2.5. Pasture resource-and-gear quest. Auto-starts after The Quiet Work is done (so it does not fight Ila or the shop at the same door). Giver Mara. E on Mara opens this dialogue before the shop while she wants to talk.

rows.name: A Warm Coat
rows.desc: Sheep for the wool, mice for the fur. Mara will cut the rest.
rows.objective: Bring Mara 8 Wool and 6 Fur, then talk to her.
rows.notes: v0.2.6. Collect from Wool Sheep (wool) and Field Mice (fur). Reward: 90 XP, 20 copper, Hide Vest ×1 (exact: Defense 3, never magic), Blueberry ×4. No skill. Gear is a quest gift, not a drop.

rows.name: What the Dirt Keeps
rows.desc: Pell wants to know what the banks are holding, under the loose earth.
rows.objective: Talk to Pell at the east gate in Meadow Town.
rows.notes: v0.2.5. Dirt Banks resource-and-gear quest. Auto-starts after The Dirt Path is done. Giver Pell.

rows.name: What the Dirt Keeps
rows.desc: Grit and a few honest chunks. The banks give them up if you ask with a blade.
rows.objective: Bring Pell 8 Earth Grit and 4 Stone Chunk, then talk to him.
rows.notes: v0.2.6. Collect from Dirt Banks regulars (Earth Sprite / Burrow Mole). Reward: 140 XP, 30 copper, Stone Club ×1 (exact: weapon damage 16, multiplier 1.15, STR 5, never magic), Nature Essence ×6. No skill. Quest gift, not a drop-table change.

rows.name: The Hero's Paths
rows.desc: Calden wants to show you how a Hero grows: by Paths.
rows.objective: Talk to Calden about Paths.
rows.notes: v0.2.7. Auto-starts when The Weight of a Swing is done. Introduces Paths, families, the chain, and points at Ila for passives.

rows.name: The Hero's Paths
rows.desc: Open the Paths window and see what is trained and what is locked.
rows.objective: Press K and look at the Warrior Path.
rows.notes: v0.2.7. Advances when the Paths window (K) is opened. Calden gives the rank 2 Power Strike materials on the way (Monster Essence 24, Training Scroll 10, Clay 16, Copper 25).

rows.name: The Hero's Paths
rows.desc: Train a rank. Skills you can afford light up.
rows.objective: Train Power Strike to rank 2, and keep it in an attack slot.
rows.notes: v0.2.7. Advances when Power Strike reaches rank 2.

rows.name: The Hero's Paths
rows.desc: Tell Calden how it felt.
rows.objective: Return to Calden.
rows.notes: v0.2.7. Rewards: 60 XP, 20 copper, Monster Essence x6, Training Scroll x4. No skill.

rows.name: The Quiet Spell
rows.desc: Tamsin walks the Magician Path, and thinks you might.
rows.objective: Talk to Tamsin in Meadow Town.
rows.notes: v0.2.8. Auto-starts when The Hero's Paths is done. Introduces the Magician Path, its chain and the MP cost; gives the Magic Bolt rank 1 materials.

rows.name: The Quiet Spell
rows.desc: Open the Paths window and look at the second tree.
rows.objective: Press K and switch to the Magician Path.
rows.notes: v0.2.8. Advances when the Magician tab is shown.

rows.name: The Quiet Spell
rows.desc: Magic Bolt is the root. Learn it and keep it in an attack slot.
rows.objective: Train Magic Bolt and keep it in an attack slot.
rows.notes: v0.2.8. Advances when Magic Bolt is learned.

rows.name: The Quiet Spell
rows.desc: Tamsin wants to hear about the mana.
rows.objective: Return to Tamsin.
rows.notes: v0.2.8. Rewards: 70 XP, 20 copper, Clear Dew x4 (MP), Monster Essence x6. No skill.
